does_not_do: It is not double-entry accounting and does not produce tax forms. A hosted Premium plan is a separate, paid service from the same team.
focus_reason: It covers the need directly: self-hosted, transactions imported by the owner, holdings over time. 155 releases in the year and a commit on the review date; 173 open issues.
measured_against: Need: track a household's holdings and transactions across accounts over time, self-hosted, from statements or exports the owner supplies.
tests_ci: A test/ directory and Jest configuration; CI workflows build the code and the Docker image.
what_it_is: A web application for tracking stocks, ETFs and crypto, built for personal use in continuous operation. Self-hosted from official Docker images; imports and exports transactions.
